label: Upkeep
description: The spell has an ongoing Upkeep cost each round while active. Grants eligibility for constant enchantments (requires Upkeep + listed duration).

label: Mindlock(X)
description: While the effect is active, the wielder (or wearer for constant) has their AP reduced by X. When used in a cast enchantment, the wielder pays the AP reduction.

label: Potion
description: This effect can be used in potion crafting. Not applicable to enchantments directly.

label: Toxin
description: This effect can be used in poison crafting.
